newsitem.title: USA: First American to buy Hartsville.
newsitem.headline: First American to buy Hartsville.

text.p: First American Corp said on Friday that it agreed to acquire Hartsville Bancshares, a $100 million institution with five branches in the Nashville area, in a deal valued at about $13.4 million.
Hartsville Bancshares operates under the name CommunityFirst Bank, First American said.

When the stock swap transaction is complete, the CommunityFirst operations will operate as First American branches, First American said. The merger will give First American a total of 71 branches in Middle Tennessee.

First American expects to repurchase in the open market all of the First American shares to be issued in connection with this transaction. All Hartsville Bancshares stock options will become options to purchase First American stock, First American said.
First American will issue about 275,000 common shares for the transaction.
The transaction is expected to be effective late in the fourth quarter 1996, or early 1997, said First American, which has $10 billion in assets and 170 banking offices.
It is expected to have a positive effect on First American's 1997 earnings, First America said.
